name: Security First
description: Enforces OWASP security practices including input validation, parameterized queries, and HTTPS.
content:
# Security First Rules

- Always use parameterized queries or ORM methods — never concatenate user input into SQL
- Sanitize and validate all user input on the server side — client validation is not enough
- Enforce HTTPS everywhere — redirect HTTP to HTTPS, set HSTS headers
- Use `Content-Security-Policy` headers to prevent XSS attacks
- Never store passwords in plain text — use bcrypt, scrypt, or argon2 with proper salt rounds
- Implement rate limiting on authentication and API endpoints
- Use CSRF tokens for all state-changing requests in server-rendered apps
- Set secure cookie flags: `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Strict`
- Never expose sensitive data in error messages, logs, or API responses
- Keep dependencies updated — run `npm audit` or equivalent regularly
- Use environment variables for secrets — never commit API keys, tokens, or credentials
- Validate file uploads: check MIME type, limit size, and store outside the web root
